REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION
TUESDAY - MAY 12, 2026 - 07:00 P.M.
CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER
18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CA 90703
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda for this meeting is available on-demand at cerritos.gov and at the Community Development Department, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 2nd floor, Cerritos, CA, 90703 during regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., weekend and observed holidays excepted). Any materials submitted to the Commission after distribution of this agenda will be available for public inspection at the Community Development Department during regular business hours. Requests for agenda materials or meeting participation assistance can also be made by email to economic_development@cerritos.gov or by phone at (562) 916-1201 during regular business hours.
Order of Agenda
The Commission, by majority of those members present, may reorder the business items listed on the agenda.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at cerritos.gov, on cable television at Cerritos TV3, or in person in the Council Chamber.
Public Comments
Members of the public may provide public comment for this meeting in person at the meeting or or in writing as described below.
In-person public comment : Public comment on business agenda items will be opened and may be provided during consideration of that business agenda item. Public comment on Consent Calendar and non-agenda items will be opened and may be provided during Agenda Item No. 6.
Written public comment (hard copy or email) : Public comment may be submitted via email to economic_development@cerritos.gov or by hard copy to the Community Development Department no later than 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. All written correspondence received by the 3:00 p.m. deadline will be distributed to the Commission prior to the meeting and retained with the official meeting record.
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact City of Cerritos ADA/504 Coordinator, Drew Schneider, at (562) 916-1314 at least 72 hours prior to the scheduled meeting. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the meeting.

MINUTES OF A REGULAR MEETING OF THE CERRITOS ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT
COMMISSION HELD TUESDAY, MAY 12, 2026, 7:00 PM, IN THE COUNCIL CHAMBER
AT CERRITOS CITY HALL, 18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA.

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Chair Reyes.

3.  Roll Call

  The following members of the Economic Development Commission were in
  attendance:

  Commissioner Aris Tagle
  Vice Chair Grace Hu
  Chair Alfred Reyes Jr.

  Commissioner Chiang was noted absent and excused by a majority consensus of the
  Economic Development Commission.

4.  Presentation of Plaque

  A plaque was presented to the outgoing Economic Development Commission Chair,
  Alfred Reyes Jr.

5.  Annual Reorganization of the Economic Development Commission

  Economic Development Manager Kiana Miranda declared the position of Chair of the
  Economic Development Commission vacant and called for nominations.

  Vice Chair Hu nominated Commissioner Tagle for Chair. Seeing no second to the
  motion for nomination, Vice Chair Hu’s nomination failed.

  Commissioner Tagle nominated Commissioner Reyes for Chair. Commissioner
  Reyes seconded the nomination.

  There were no other nominations, and nominations were closed.

  MOTION: Commissioner Tagle nominated Commissioner Reyes for Chair.
  Commissioner Reyes seconded the nomination.

  The motion carried (3-0-1-0) as follows:

  AYES:  Hu, Tagle, Reyes
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Chiang
  ABSTAIN:  None

  Commissioner Reyes was declared Chair of the Economic Development
  Commission.

  Economic Development Manager Kiana Miranda declared the position of Vice

  Chair of the Economic Development Commission vacant and called for
  nominations.

  Commissioner Hu nominated Commissioner Tagle for Vice Chair. Seeing no
  second to the motion for nomination, Vice Chair Hu’s nomination failed.

  Commissioner Tagle nominated Commissioner Chiang for Vice Chair. Chair
  Reyes seconded the nomination.

  There were no other nominations, and nominations were then closed.

  MOTION: Commissioner Tagle nominated Commissioner Chiang for Vice Chair.
  Chair Reyes seconded the nomination.

  The motion carried (3-0-1-0) as follows:

  AYES:  Hu, Tagle, Reyes
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Chiang
  ABSTAIN:  None

  Commissioner Chiang was declared Vice Chair of the Economic Development
  Commission.

  To allow the Chair and Vice Chair to take their new seats at the dais, a meeting
  recess was called by Economic Development Manager Kiana Miranda.

6.  Public Comments and Suggestions

  The Chair opened the public comments period. Seeing none, the Chair declared the
  public comments period closed.

7.  Consent Calendar

7A.  Approval of Minutes

  Tuesday, March 10, 2026, 7:00 p.m. Cerritos Economic Development
  Commission Regular Meeting Minutes.

  MOTION: It was moved by Chair Reyes, and seconded by Commissioner Tagle, to
  approve the Tuesday, March 10, 2026, 7:00 p.m. Economic Development
  Commission Regular Meeting Minutes.

  The motion carried (3-0-1-0) as follows:

  AYES:  Hu, Tagle, Reyes
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Chiang
  ABSTAIN:  None

8.  New and Old Business

8A.  Review and consideration of an informational report regarding the programs and
  services provided by the Gateway Cities Council of Governments (Gateway Cities
  COG).
 City of Cerritos  Tuesday, May 12, 2026, 7:00 p.m.
Economic Development Commission Regular Meeting  Page 3 of 4

  A brief introduction was given by Economic Development Manager Kiana
  Miranda. A presentation was given by Transportation Analyst of the
  Gateway Cities Council of Governments Patrick Lewis. Mr. Lewis provided a brief
  background on the Gateway Cities COG and how it is comprised of
  twenty-seven (27) member cities. He continued his presentation, outlining the
  organization’s role in coordinating regional initiatives related to economic
  development, transportation, housing, workforce development, and other programs
  that support quality of life and long-term regional competitiveness.

  Discussion continued with the Commission regarding the regional fiber-optic network
  and the relationship between private companies that manage broadband services
  and provide them to consumers.

  The Economic Development Commission received and filed the report.

8B.  Review and consideration of an informational report regarding economic
  development updates in the City of Cerritos, including building permit activity and
  on-going development projects.

  A staff report was given by Economic Development Manager Kiana Miranda.
  A PowerPoint presentation displayed current development projects and building
  permit activity. Ms. Miranda continued by explaining how building permit activities
  reflect property owner initiatives to improve and invest in their properties, including
  both residential and commercial developments. Ms. Miranda concluded her
  presentation by stating that continued construction activity helps attract new
  business by ensuring the City maintains an up-to-date, modern appearance.

  Discussion continued with the Commission regarding the former Amazon Fresh
  Store, the permitting timeline in which proposed projects are approved and
  completed, potential development for the former Sears site, and the anticipated
  opening of Ono Hawaiian Grill.

  The Economic Development Commission received and filed the report.

8C.  Review and consideration of an informational report regarding recent City of
  Cerritos business recognition program recipients.

  A staff report was given by Economic Development Manager Kiana Miranda.
  A PowerPoint presentation displayed recent Cerritos business recognition program
  recipients. Ms. Miranda continued by showing the City of Cerritos Mayor’s Business
  Recognition program video for Silverlake Ramen. Ms. Miranda concluded her
  presentation by showing the City of Cerritos Business Spotlight program video for
  Islands Restaurant and Chick-fil-A.

  Discussion continued with the Commission regarding how businesses can be
  nominated for recognition, and inviting the Commission to dine in Cerritos.

  The Economic Development Commission received and filed the report.

9.  Reports

9A.  Report from Designated Commission Staff Liaison

  There were no reports from the Designated Commission Liaison to the Economic
  Development Commission.

  Reports were given by Commissioners Tagle and Chair Reyes.

  The meeting adjourned at 8:19 p.m.
